_comment: Taught moves (private, on-device) and user sounds (GDD §5.4). Public uploads stay OFF until an IP lawyer has reviewed the terms and takedown process (GDD §11 M6).

attestation.ar: هذا الصوت من إنتاجي أو أملك حقوقه، وما فيه أغنية أو مقطع لغيري، وكل من يُسمع صوته فيه وافق.
attestation.en: I made this sound or own its rights; it contains no one else's song or clip, and everyone heard in it agreed.
